title: Vite React frontend scaffold with vanilla CSS design tokens
description: Scaffold the React application inside web/ with Vite, index.html, and a comprehensive vanilla CSS design system in src/index.css implementing the PRD's calm, professional light theme (clean cards, pale gray background, muted blue accents, restrained alert colors).
acceptanceCriteria: Vite React application configured with npm run dev running on port 3000
Design system in web/src/index.css defines CSS variables for colors, typography, shadows, border radii, and spacing
Theme strictly follows PRD 6.1: light background (#f8fafc), white cards (#ffffff), dark slate text (#1e293b), muted blue accents (#2563eb), green/amber/red status indicators
Responsive dashboard layout grid defined for desktop and mobile

steps.description: Configure web application package.json and vite.config.js
steps.details: Create web/package.json with React 18/19 and Vite; configure vite.config.js with server port 3000 and proxy to FastAPI at port 8000.

steps.description: Create web/index.html with proper SEO and typography
steps.details: Create web/index.html with Inter / Roboto fonts, viewport meta tag, and title 'DrishtiDrive AI — Drowsiness Detection Dashboard'.

steps.description: Implement vanilla CSS design tokens in web/src/index.css
steps.details: Define :root CSS tokens for colors, card styling, typography, buttons, inputs, transitions, and status colors adhering to PRD 6.1.
Create App.jsx with header container, main two-column responsive grid container, and placeholder panels.
Run Playwright test navigating to http://localhost:3000, verify header and card layout render cleanly, and capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-20-1.png.

technicalNotes: Use Vanilla CSS rather than heavy TailwindCSS frameworks adhering to design guidelines.
Ensure contrast meets WCAG AA readability standards.
